title: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Savior
lyrics_original: Pass me not, O gentle Savior,
While on others Thou art calling,
While on others Thou art calling,
Let me at Thy throne of mercy
While on others Thou art calling,
While on others Thou art calling,
Thou the Spring of all my comfort,
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
While on others Thou art calling,

bible_verses.english: The tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

Behold, two blind men sat by the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!” The multitude sternly warned them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!” Jesus stood still, and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?” They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.” Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, my gentle Savior, I come to You today with an open and humble heart. In a world full of noise, I lift my quiet cry to You, trusting in Your boundlessly tender love. Do not pass me by, Lord, but draw me close to Your throne of mercy where my soul finds true relief. Thank You for hearing my voice and meeting me right where I am. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Like the blind men by the roadside who called out to Jesus despite the crowd, "Pass Me Not, O Gentle Savior" expresses our deep, honest longing for the Lord’s presence. It is a humble cry born not of fear, but of faith in a Savior whose mercy never runs dry. When we feel overlooked or weary, this hymn reminds us that Jesus stops for the contrite heart. As you sing today, bring your quiet burdens to His throne of mercy, confident that He delights in drawing near to you.
